name: The Fate of Yenniku

meta.previous: Speaking with Gan'zulah, Speaking with Nezzliok (Classic)

summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, the head of Nezzliok speaks from the bubbling cauldron, ready to tell what became of the young Darkspear troll Yenniku. Kin'weelay stands beside the pot, waiting to hear the spirit's words.

sections.title: Words from the Kettle
sections.body: Having placated the spirits of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok, you listen as the head within the bubbling cauldron finally imparts its secret. Kin'weelay stands right beside the cauldron, waiting to hear it.

sections.title: What the Head Revealed
sections.body: Nezzliok declares that Yenniku is lost to his clan, taken by the witch doctor Zanzil the Outcast. Zanzil has bound the boy completely, and nothing short of very strong magic will free him. Kin'weelay, hearing it, is left with only a faint hope.

faq.answer: The head of Nezzliok speaks through the bubbling cauldron to disclose what happened to Yenniku.

faq.q: Who should be informed of Nezzliok's words?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay, who stands right beside the bubbling cauldron at the northern edge of Grom'gol Base Camp, needs to hear what Nezzliok revealed.

angles.text: Recovering the chief's son is vital for the Darkspear tribe and their allies stationed within Grom'gol Base Camp.
